spec.explain: Illustrative toy of arXiv 2106.09685 showing LoRA update as two thin matrices versus full width-by-width update; the rank limit keeps trained parameters small.

questions.q: Predict what r = 4 means for the shape of the two LoRA factors with d = 256?
Many think full fine-tuning with d = 256 needs similar parameters to r = 4; what is wrong before you move r?
How would you describe the savings if d = 512 while holding r = 2?
Why keep r = 8 small when d = 512 instead of raising rank toward width?

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var r = state.r; var d = state.d; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); var S = 40 + d * 0.22; var thin = 8 + r * 9; var y0 = 96; var xF = 36; var xB = 250; var xA = 250 + thin + 18; ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1915"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("full d by d vs LoRA pair", 36, 30); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(xF, y0, S, S); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1c1915"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeRect(xF, y0, S, S); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(xB, y0, thin, S); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1c1915"; ctx.strokeRect(xB, y0, thin, S); ctx.fillStyle = "#2e7d5b"; ctx.fillRect(xA, y0, S, thin); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1c1915"; ctx.strokeRect(xA, y0, S, thin); ctx.strokeStyle = "#5c564c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; var i = 0; for (i = 1; i < r; i = i + 1) { var lx = xB + i * thin / r; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx, y0); ctx.lineTo(lx, y0 + S); ctx.stroke(); } var j = 0; for (j = 1; j < r; j = j + 1) { var ly = y0 + j * thin / r; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xA, ly); ctx.lineTo(xA + S, ly); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1915"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("full d by d", xF, y0 + S + 20); ctx.fillText("B d by r", xB, y0 + S + 20); ctx.fillText("A r by d", xA, y0 + S + 20); ctx.fillText("d = " + fmt(d), xF, y0 + S + 38); ctx.fillText("r = " + fmt(r), xB, y0 + S + 38); var lora = 2 * d * r; var full = d * d; ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillText("lora_params = " + fmt(lora), 36, 318); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillText("full_params = " + fmt(full), 250, 318); ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1915"; ctx.fillText("B times A makes d by d update", 250, 52); }
